title: Roles desk: server owns sort, status filter and the 20-row window
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: 'status' is in the server sort allowlist as a CASE over the roleStatus rank (open, draft, filled, closed) bound to the same overlay + hired subquery, pinned in case 5 (asc and desc); sort='salary' orders by the salary_min column, declared in code, commit and doc. Both adopted leftovers ('Drive the Jobs pager from GET /api/jobs offset', 'Do not client-filter filled status only on the truncated page') closed by ca9056f8b. Series shape: instead of a red test-only commit first, each feat commit carries its own tests so every commit is green (store+route+their tests, then client+its tests, then the doc under the lock). Case 7 (default-order contract) is a guard, green before by design, so red-before is 7 of 8. Added a routes-level `hired` via the store (withHired) and removed the route's separate listJobPipelineStats pass. Status allowlist restated in db/jobs.ts as JOB_ROLE_STATUSES (a value import of status-tone put +1 module on ~10 route graphs); parity with ROLE_STATUSES and with the table's JobSortCol set is pinned in jobs-browse.test.ts. jobsTableView.ts accessors kept as reference semantics (header comment updated); no longer imported for value, so it left the page graph.
notes: tsc: `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 2 ONLY on the untracked foreign `kpi-sim/runs/**` tree (present at base, not mine); zero errors outside kpi-sim/. test:unit: 10529/10530 on the live tree, the one failure app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts 'aborted spawn kills the whole process tree' is load-sensitive and passes alone (3/3), untouched by this card. test:perf: RED on the live shared tree (page.tsx 8993/8992, ~14 api route overrides +3..5 KB) from siblings' UNCOMMITTED files; measured base+my files alone via git archive and the committed HEAD f2848392d: findings 0, page.tsx 8979 KB (-11 KB vs base 8990: JobsTabResults dropped useTableSort/pageSlice and jobsTableView left the graph), so no ceiling raised. api:check green (route/method/auth unchanged; response only adds `window`). The ingest latch miss now point-fetches (a 404 would show the existing 'no such role' notice). SQL fold deviation (Czech ch / caron letters) documented. The `jobs.tab.showingCut` catalog key is now unused on this desk but left in the catalogs (no messages edit).
